rows.why: Low pressure keeps the suit flexible; astronauts pre-breathe pure O₂ first to purge nitrogen and avoid the bends.
Between suit and Earth air, to shorten pre-breathing before moonwalks. Over 40 % more oxygen fraction than Earth air (30/21 = 1.43), so materials burn more readily.

source: NASA Space Apps 2026 challenge brief (Flame in Freefall); NASA atmospheres in ACME BRE (PSI-20)
